title: Ghost of Tsushima observed identifier catalog
description: Small raw-ID catalog for PS5 Tsushima saves. It names observed identifiers without asserting ownership, equipped state, capacities or write semantics.

attribution.modifications: Names and raw identifiers were transcribed from privately retained Tsushima evidence; no game text, images or third-party code is embedded.
